basis: The legend explicitly maps darker burgundy to '0 High' and lighter yellow to '100 Low'. Among the available options (NC, NY, DE), New York (NY) is shaded in dark burgundy, indicating the highest prevalence. North Carolina (NC) is pale yellow (lowest), and Delaware (DE) is light orange (moderate). Therefore, New York (NY) is the highest-prevalence state according to the dashboard's encoding.
